items.title: The Fed says inflation hasn’t gotten any better ahead of its key December vote to raise rates

items.title: Inflation gets worse. Now the Fed has no choice but to raise U.S. interest rates.
items.sum: The measure of inflation used by the Federal Reserve to influence U.S. interest rates rose again in October at an accelerated rate, virtually assuring the central bank will increase borrowing costs next month.

items.title: Fed’s preferred inflation gauge accelerated to 3.8% in October, raising the 2027 stakes for the central bank
items.sum: The personal consumption expenditures price index was expected to show an annual inflation rate of 3.8% in October, according to the Dow Jones consensus.
